# function: finspace_api_credential

Builds the ARN for `finspace-api` `credential`:

```
arn:${Partition}:finspace-api:${Region}:${Account}:/credentials/programmatic
```

The partition, region and account fields come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# arn:aws:finspace-api:ap-northeast-1:111111111111:/credentials/programmatic
output "finspace_api_credential" {
  value = provider::arn::finspace_api_credential()
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
finspace_api_credential(options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->

<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given. An unrecognized key, or a value set to an empty string, is an error; omit an option, or set it to `null`, to use the default.
